title: Coursebook shared vocabulary v1
description: Single authority for every enum shared by more than one Coursebook contract. Other contracts reference these definitions by absolute $id; nothing may redeclare them.
x-change-policy: Semantic changes require a new version file and an Atlas decision recorded in docs/CONTRACTS.md.

recipe.description: Course recipe. Parent recipes are authored in Parent Studio, never in a learner chat.

evidence_class.description: How an attempt's evidence was produced. Only `cold` can count as independent evidence; `override` grants access, never mastery.

evidence_target.description: What a check measures. Recognition may not substitute for production; a repeated near-identical item may not substitute for transfer.

verdict.description: Outcome of grading one attempt. `needs_retry` means the grader could not finish; it never advances state. `clarification` consumes no retry and creates no error evidence.

next_action.description: The only permitted transition the backend offers after a committed attempt.

answer_kind.description: Contest attempts are text or structured selections only. Audio/image answers are rejected with a text alternative.

objective_state.description: Objective state vocabulary. Evidence states are deliberately distinct; there is no global `mastered`.

binding_status.description: Lesson session binding status. Only `active` may accept a submit.

job_kind.description: Backend job families. Research and media never run inside the pre-turn grading hook.

pack_trust_label.description: Trust dimensions kept separate on purpose. There is no universal safe/true/verified badge.

source_support_status.description: Claim support is an assessment, not provenance. Provenance alone never implies support.

locale.description: BCP-47-shaped locale tag. Content and grading assumptions attach to it.

identifier.description: Random, Coursebook-minted id. Titles and paths are never identity.

revision.description: Monotonic per aggregate. Compare-and-swap fence for every mutation.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC with an explicit offset.
